question: Does an auxiliary same-cutoff EMA teacher target on learned embedding coordinates improve fixed1024 linear readout balance over the original scattered reconstruction recipe?

decision.interpretation: The fixed1024 development continuation criterion failed; this declared teacher-method comparison does not support advancement.

comparison.control: The exact three original scattered-mask coefficient0.1 final1024 controls and audited heads from V18 are reused without training or head replay.

comparison.intended_change: One auxiliary EMA-teacher learning method with a training-only predictor; base architecture/served output capacity, scattered mask, Gaussian-plus-temporal objective, preprocessing, row streams and fixed evaluation are retained.

comparison.extra_training_capacity: Teacher repeats the configured model state and adds one no-gradient full-view encode per successful candidate update. Predictor is trainable only during training; neither appears in served-student inference.
comparison.paired_state_identity_limit: Shared base-student/scaler/bank FNV tensor-byte identities and realized row/attempt checks are engineering witnesses, not cryptographic tensor equality proofs.
comparison.evaluation: Unchanged112 TRAIN/32 known January VALIDATION H256 anchors retaining128; original legacy F32-to-F64 targets; TRAIN-standardized ridge1; unchanged independent scalar audit/tolerance.
